text:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR 7322 (hotfix: kv-cache OOM) needs 2x LGTM before 02:00 UTC cutover. CI is green but @leo saw a flaky mem test. Link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7322

owen: On my way to review, give me ~20m. Which areas should I focus on?

maria: Main surface is the warmup path + cache eviction. If those look sane, rollback is just reverting the PR.

ci-bot: CI ✓ all checks passed: build, unit, e2e, smoke. No blocking failures.

jess: I can take perf and regression. @leo can you paste the flake logs here?

leo: pasted logs: gist.github.com/leo/kv-flake (repro snippet below)
```
=== FAIL: TestKVWarmup (0.03s)
    warmup_test.go:47: expected <nil>, got OOM
```

leo: flake looks timing-sensitive on small machines, not on dedicated runners. Not blocking if canary runs on dedicated.

sam: pinging @eng-sre — do we have a dedicated 15min canary slot after cutover? Need to make sure we can observe memory behavior.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved: eu-west-1 shard, 02:10–02:25 UTC. Alerting hooks wired to #incidents and PagerDuty.

jess: Reviewing now. Left one nit in the PR (rename var), not blocking. Verified warmup logic looks fine. :thumbsup:

owen: Addressed jess's nit and pushed force-push. Re-ran unit tests locally. LGTM from me.

maria: That should be 2x LGTM (owen + jess). I'll schedule merge at 01:55 UTC and kick the rollout at 02:00 UTC. Anyone object?

ci-bot: Merge checks passed for head sha abc123. No conflicts.

maria: OK queued. If anything goes sideways we revert with: `./scripts/revert-pr 7322` and tag @sam for rollback ops.

deploy-bot: Auto-merge scheduled at 01:55 UTC. Rollout will start at 02:00 UTC with canary window at 02:10 UTC.

maria: Thanks team — monitoring channel will be #prod-watch. I’ll post quick postmortem if we see instability.

jess: thanks — will watch logs and perf dashboards.

leo: good to go from my side.

maria: closing the loop — two LGTM achieved, merge queued, canary reserved. Good job everyone :party:
